title: Cloud/DevOps Associate
source: O*NET Online (15-1251.00 - Computer Systems Engineers/DevOps) & Linux Foundation / AWS Certified SysOps & Solutions Architect Associate Frameworks
description: Automates software delivery pipelines, manages resilient cloud infrastructure via code (IaC), ensures high availability and security, and monitors production workloads.

rubric.1: Novice: Understands cloud computing definitions (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and basic terminal commands. Requires manual step-by-step guidance to launch a virtual machine.
rubric.2: Advanced Beginner: Can launch cloud instances via the web console, execute basic Bash scripts, and build simple Docker containers from existing examples.
rubric.3: Competent (Job-Ready Baseline): Autonomously provisions cloud infrastructure using Terraform, authors multi-stage GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, configures secure IAM policies, and troubleshoots Linux networking.
rubric.4: Proficient: Designs fault-tolerant multi-zone cloud architectures, implements automated rolling deployments with rollback triggers, optimizes cloud infrastructure costs, and establishes centralized observability.
rubric.5: Expert: Architects multi-cloud hybrid systems, defines enterprise zero-trust security postures, directs disaster recovery simulations, and mentors operations engineering teams.

requirements.description: Mastery of Linux CLI navigation, file system permissions (chmod, chown), process management (systemd, top/ps), cron scheduling, and Bash automation scripts.
Configuring Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), public/private subnets, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Route Tables, Security Groups, and Elastic Load Balancers.
Building lean, secure multi-stage Docker images, configuring container networking and persistent volumes, and running container workloads.
Authoring automated Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI with linting, testing, and cloud deployment steps.
Declarative cloud provisioning with Terraform: managing providers, state files, modular resource blocks, variable definitions, and idempotency.
Implementing least-privilege IAM roles and policies, configuring MFA, rotating API credentials, and securing environment secrets with Vault or Cloud Secrets Manager.
Setting up centralized log aggregation, defining SLIs/SLOs, configuring health metric alarms, and instrumenting dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana.
Managing infrastructure configurations through Git with pull request verification, automated plan generation, and code review audit trails.

project_templates.title: Automated End-to-End Cloud CI/CD & Infrastructure Pipeline
project_templates.brief: Provision a resilient VPC network using Terraform modules, build a secure multi-stage Docker container for a web API, and configure a GitHub Actions workflow that automatically tests and deploys changes on git merge.
deliverables: Modular Terraform codebase creating VPC, security groups, and cloud server instances
Multi-stage Dockerfile and GitHub Actions pipeline YAML file with automated testing
Architecture diagram (Draw.io/PNG) with traffic flow and security zones
project_templates.evidence_output: Public GitHub repository with IaC code, passing CI/CD badge, and deployment documentation.

project_templates.title: Production Observability & Automated Health Monitoring System
project_templates.brief: Set up a centralized monitoring stack using Prometheus and Grafana to track latency, CPU, and error rate metrics. Configure automated alert rules triggered when HTTP 5xx errors breach thresholds.
deliverables: Docker Compose stack orchestrating Prometheus, Node Exporter, and Grafana
Exported Grafana Dashboard JSON with golden signals visualization
Incident response Runbook (Markdown) documenting recovery steps for threshold breaches
project_templates.evidence_output: Public GitHub repository containing monitoring configuration, exported dashboard JSON, and Runbook markdown.
